title: Meet another Millersville grad from the Drumore Friends Meeting  - Quaker Thomas B
summaryTitle: Thomas Benton Hambleton, Millersville graduate and Civil War soldier
excerpt: Meet another Millersville grad from the Drumore Friends Meeting - Quaker Thomas Benton Hambleton. After attending Chestnut Level Academy, he studied at Millersville State Normal School. Upon graduation he began teaching in the southern end

allImages.caption: Fernglen store - Thomas is on the far left. His wife, Lib, is behind the fence. Their home is on the left and store is on the right.
